title: Crash when using command line `--import` to import resources in a project for the first time
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.8.dev4, 4.8.dev cb41ea115
- Not reproducible in: 4.7.2.stable, 4.8.dev3

### System information

Godot v4.8.dev (cb41ea115) - Fedora Linux 44 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor (3840x2160 @ 240.02 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 610.57.04) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Crash when using command line `--import` to import resources in a project for the first time.

This does not occur when using the editor's standard import process (outside the command line), or if resources are already imported in `.godot/`.

I bisected the regression to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/113051. cc @KoBeWi 

### Steps to reproduce

- Ensure the `.godot/` folder is *not* present in the project folder.
- Run `path/to/godot.binary --import --path /path/to/project`; it will always crash when `.godot/` is not present.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test_import_crash.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/32076606/test_import_crash.zip)
